# Chatbot use case (`support-chatbot`)

Documentation, telemetry contract, dashboards, alerts and failure scenarios: **[docs/use-cases/chatbot.md](../../docs/use-cases/chatbot.md)**.

```bash
pip install -r use-cases/requirements.txt
python use-cases/chatbot/app/chatbot_app.py --cycle 240        # needs the stack from ../stack (or add --console)
```

* `app/` instrumented demo application (simulated model/tool calls, no API keys)
* `dashboards/` Grafana JSON, generated by `scripts/gen_dashboards.py`
* `alerts/` Prometheus recording and alerting rules
